archetypes.name: doc-contract
archetypes.rationale: Reference docs carry exact operational contracts for implement recovery.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the orchestrator and stall-recovery prose for contract drift. Check that premature-notification recovery remains narrow and that submodule-restricted stalls do not inherit protected-path inline repair semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: rebalance-spread
archetypes.rationale: The rebalance warning now depends on packed shard totals instead of a pre-pack heuristic.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the rebalance feasibility change and tests. Verify the post-pack spread calculation handles empty layouts, missing medians, extras, and warning-only behavior without changing packing semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: structured-severity
archetypes.rationale: Structured reviewer validation must match accepted prompt severity vocabulary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the structured reviewer validation changes. Confirm blocking severity is accepted in both JSONL and TSV paths while existing lowercase normalization and invalid-record rejection stay unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
